task_completion.description: Agent successfully logs into the wger fitness manager using admin credentials.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The dashboard or main menu of wger is visible, showing 'admin' as the logged-in user.

task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the exercise database/catalog.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A list of exercises or the 'Exercises' menu item is active/visible.

task_completion.description: Agent selects the standard 'Deadlift' exercise, avoiding variations like 'Romanian Deadlift'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The detail page for 'Deadlift' is displayed; the title must exactly match 'Deadlift'.

task_completion.description: Agent initiates the process to add or link a video to the exercise.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A form, modal, or input field for 'YouTube video', 'Video URL', or 'Add video' is visible on the Deadlift page.

task_completion.description: Agent enters the specific YouTube URL provided in the task.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The URL 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wYREQkVtvEc' or the ID 'wYREQkVtvEc' is typed into the video link field.

task_completion.description: Agent submits the form to save the video link to the exercise.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A success message (e.g., 'Video added') appears, or the Deadlift page now displays the linked video/thumbnail.

integrity.description: The agent used the web interface rather than executing database commands via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks, and typing within the browser window, not just a command line.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the application rather than guessing the direct URL to the edit page.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the agent clicking through the menu and exercise list to reach the Deadlift page.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the local wger instance.
integrity.visual_evidence: The browser address bar shows 'localhost' or the designated local IP for the wger application.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target exercise must be exactly 'Deadlift' (not Romanian, Stiff-leg, etc.). The required YouTube ID is 'wYREQkVtvEc'. Verification is successful if this specific video ID is linked to the specific 'Deadlift' entry in the wger GUI.
